settings.angular_definition: Linear polarization measured at 90 deg; angular distribution measured at multiple angles with escape-suppressed Ge(Li) spectrometer normalized to external singles monitor (full angle list not tabulated in text; a2, a4 corrected for solid-angle attenuation).

settings.gate: Singles angular distribution in escape-suppressed spectrometer normalized to external singles monitor in polarimeter scatterer; separate gamma-gamma coincidence at 8.0, 8.5, 12.0 MeV with two Ge(Li) detectors at 90 deg used for level decay scheme.
settings.polarization_calibration: Three-Ge(Li) Compton polarimeter at 90 deg to beam axis; calibration and polarization sensitivity Q referenced to Butler et al. (1973) NIM 108, 497.
settings.curve_evaluation: Joint sum of squared residuals combining compound-nucleus alignment predictions, angular distribution coefficients (a2, a4), and linear polarization P(90) minimized simultaneously over delta and alignment parameters (beta, x).
settings.final_alignment_condition: δ 与取向参数联合最小化；复合核模型预测参与残差约束。未采用一个固定 σ/I。
